title: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such… (CVE-2026-101353)
description: LibreOffice Base documents can embed an HSQLDB database, and other documents can use this database as a data source. A crafted document could define the embedded database in a way that causes the database engine to create or write files outside the document's intended location. Fixed versions restrict embedded database files to a private location and prevent creation of table files elsewhere.
